verifier_revision_details: Preserved failure: the frozen V2 checker reported invalid_rows=227 after metadata-binding failures. Native diagnosis found 127 copied floating-point tokens, each exactly one decoded f64 ULP from its original after Rust parsing/reserialization. V3 changes only four observation-copy comparisons, allowing adjacent finite f64 values at explicit diagnostic paths. Integer/coordinate/scalar/seed/counter/nanosecond/hash/configuration gates remain exact; two ULPs and one-nanosecond changes are rejected. The original frozen collect command then failed exact observation reconstruction; a separate versioned collect-only program uses arbitrary-precision JSON tokens and the V3 file seal, without recalculating clocks or launching solvers. Original failures, sources, observations and all measured bytes remain unchanged. This is a post-hoc validation/extraction correction, not a newly measured solver improvement.
method_choice: For the measured retained-base one-target workload and the actual 32-target shared workload, the optimized rho implementation has lower complete-process cost. IC's secondary producer-query mean is lower, but its target-block and crossed intervals include equal cost, its upper query tail is higher, and its clock omits validation/input/output work included by rho. The observed data therefore support using this rho configuration for these two executed workload sizes on this host. They do not establish global optimality or an executed larger-batch IC crossover.
model_details: Native model point threshold: N=1,685, beyond the only measured shared size N=32. Of 20,000 crossed-bootstrap draws, 814 (fraction 0.0407) have no eventual IC advantage in the linear model. The unconditional extended 95% interval starts at 844 targets and has a nonfinite upper endpoint. Finite-only descriptive quantiles are median 1,602, p025 840 and p975 11,270.125; these condition on finite draws and are not an unconditional confidence interval. Native setup-plus-query prefixes are derived producer-accounted prefixes, not observed prefix wall times. No larger crossover was executed. Projected costs may exceed the current 2100 s cap; larger N requires a new prospective equal-budget protocol.
